task.ques: On ArXiv, what categories does Economics include, and what are their abbreviations?

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: ArXiv’s Economics archive includes three categories:
- Econometrics — econ.EM
- General Economics — econ.GN
- Theoretical Economics — econ.TH

Evidence: ArXiv’s Economics archive, “Categories within Economics,” https://arxiv.org/archive/econ (viewed October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
